_doc: MISUMI HFS8-4590: a 90 x 45 mm aluminium extrusion of its 8-45 series, clear anodised (HFSB8-4590 is the same section in black). Dimensions, area, second moments and mass are from MISUMI's catalogue page; it is described lying flat, so inertia_x is the smaller second moment (bending across the 45 mm). The drawn outline leaves out the four lobes round the bore, the V marks on the core and the hollows' rounded corners. MISUMI prints no section modulus or torsion constant.
name: profile-4590-misumi-hfs8

family.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

series.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

cells_across.rule: 2 cells side by side: 2 slots in each wide face
cells_across.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

cells_up.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

height.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

corner_radius.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

slot.rule: Every face has the 8-45 series' slot
slot.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

chamber_width.rule: The closed hollow between the two cells, behind a wall dimensioned 3 on the drawing each side: 45 less 6
chamber_width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

chamber_length.rule: The hollow keeps its full width for about 19 mm, a wall of about 3.0 mm from each neighbouring slot's cavity, then steps in to the flanks. Not dimensioned
chamber_length.source: scaled off the section drawing on MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf (the drawing prints no figure for it)

bore_diameter.rule: Centre bore of each cell, "2-Ø12.5" on the drawing. MISUMI taps it M12 only through a Heli-coil insert (page 2-757), so no bore_thread is given
bore_diameter.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

corner_hollow_width.rule: A closed square hollow in each corner, 7.5 on the drawing (its corners are rounded there; drawn square here)
corner_hollow_width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

corner_hollow_wall.rule: The wall outside each corner hollow, 2.5 on the drawing
corner_hollow_wall.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

area.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

inertia_x.rule: Cross sectional moment of inertia 32.29 x 10^4 mm⁴ (the page's lx: the smaller, bending across the 45 mm)
inertia_x.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

inertia_y.rule: Cross sectional moment of inertia 124.7 x 10^4 mm⁴ (the page's ly: the larger, bending across the 90 mm)
inertia_y.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

mass_per_metre.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

alloy.rule: Material of the HFS type, as the page's table gives it (the NFS type of the same section is A6063S-T5)
alloy.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

material.rule: The kit's rule set for A6N01SS-T5, from MISUMI's own mechanical properties table
material.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-514, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_513.pdf

cut_length_min.rule: Configurable length, from 50 mm in 0.5 mm steps
cut_length_min.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

cut_length_max.rule: Configurable length, to 4000 mm (6000 for some, by special order)
cut_length_max.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-684, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_683.pdf

cut_tolerance.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-679, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_679.pdf

straightness_per_metre.rule: Bend: 0.3 mm or less in any 300 mm for a circumscribed circle over 38 mm (this section's is 100.6 mm), which is 1.00 mm in a metre. JIS special grade, as MISUMI's tolerance page gives it
straightness_per_metre.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-514, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_513.pdf

twist_per_metre.rule: Twist: 1/4 degree or less in any 300 mm for a circumscribed circle over 76 mm (100.6 mm here), at most 3 degrees over the whole length. JIS special grade, as MISUMI's tolerance page gives it
twist_per_metre.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-514, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_513.pdf
